name: onchain-rpg-client
description: TypeScript client for On-Chain RPG Solana program

scripts.fund: echo 'Run: solana transfer $(cat .wallet/test-wallet.json | bun run -e "console.log(require(\'@solana/web3.js\').Keypair.fromSecretKey(new Uint8Array(JSON.parse(require(\'fs\').readFileSync(0,\'utf-8\')))).publicKey.toBase58())") 0.2 --url devnet'
